# X-Terminal

> Interactive Web Terminal of XeraFun (xerafun.com), hosted at https://terminal.xerafun.com.

## Overview

- URL: https://terminal.xerafun.com
- Main Site: https://xerafun.com
- Author: xerafun
- GitHub: https://github.com/xerafun/x-terminal

## Ecosystem

- [XeraFun](https://xerafun.com): Main digital portal.
- [X-Terminal](https://terminal.xerafun.com): Web terminal portfolio.
- [Blog](https://xerafun.github.io): Tech blog.
- [X-Texas-Holdem](https://x-texas-holdem.pages.dev): Web game.

## Commands

- `xerafun`: Open the main site (xerafun.com).
- `about`: Display bio and site information.
- `projects` / `ls`: List GitHub repositories.
- `banner`: Show welcome banner.
- `weather [city]`: Check city weather.
- `quote`: Show inspirational quote.
- `whoami`: Print current shell username.
- `help`: List commands.
- `clear`: Clear screen.
